description: Actively maintained continuation of com.arthenica:ffmpeg-kit-video (retired, archived April 2025). Same com.arthenica.ffmpegkit API, drop-in replacement -- just change the groupId. Video codecs: dav1d, fontconfig, freetype, fribidi, kvazaar, libass, libiconv, libtheora, libvpx, libwebp, snappy, zimg. Android SDK 35, 16 KB page size, security-tracked. By Jokobee -- jokobee.com
